This is a demonstration store. You can purchase products like this from Ugmonk.

A beautiful mechanical puzzle comprised of three identical pieces, die-cast in stainless steel and weighing almost 2 pounds.

The Venn Puzzle is a surprisingly difficult dexterity challenge and intriguing addition to your desk, shelf, or coffee table. The assembled puzzle creates a perfect sphere — so each piece makes up one-third of the sphere by volume. These pieces are cast from molten stainless steel in a ‘die’ or mold at temperatures over 2500°F.

Craighill is a design studio in Brooklyn, NY focused on creating products to be as functional and timeless as they are beautiful and intriguing
